name: remotefarm
description: Keep the records of your farm in RemoteFarm from ChatGPT: crops, animals, livestock groups, bees, finances, tasks and workers.

interface.longDescription:
RemoteFarm is a farm management app for crops, livestock, bees, finances, tasks and workers. Connect it to ChatGPT to read and update your farm records in a conversation.

Ask what is due this week. Search animal health records. Get the income and expenses for a month. Log a weight, a vaccination, a harvest or a hive inspection. Add a task with a reminder.

You sign in to RemoteFarm to connect. ChatGPT sees only the farms you belong to, and only what your role on each farm allows.

The tools add and update records. One tool removes something: a sale takes the sold animal off the farm. No tool deletes a record or moves money.
defaultPrompt: What is due on my farm this week?
How much did the farm earn and spend this month?
Which tasks on my farm are overdue?

positive.description: See what is due on the farm
positive.prompt: What is due on my farm in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open tasks and the next vaccinations due in the next 14 days on Demo Valley Farm, including Bella's CDT booster on 2026-10-30. Overdue items are marked overdue.

positive.description: Income and expenses for the month
positive.prompt: How much did the farm earn and spend this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the income, expense and net for this month in the farm's currency.

positive.prompt: Record that Bella the goat weighed 42 kg today.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Bella's animal ID, saves one weight record of 42 kg with today's date and replies with the record number.

positive.prompt: Add a task to spray the maize on North Field next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one task with next Monday as the due date and replies with the task number.
Lists Bella's two vaccination records (PPR and CDT), newest first, with the next due dates.

negative.description: Payment request. No tool moves money, so the plugin must not act. Expected: ChatGPT says it cannot make a payment and may offer to record the expense instead.
Bulk delete. No tool deletes records, and the sale tool is for a real sale only. Expected: ChatGPT says it cannot delete records and calls no tool.
Out of scope. RemoteFarm has no weather data. Expected: ChatGPT calls no RemoteFarm tool.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Nairobi tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: 45 tools that read and update crops, animals, livestock groups, bees, finances, tasks and workers.
